{{Short description|Shopping mall operator}} {{Use dmy dates|date=April 2022}} {{Infobox company | name = McArthurGlen UK Limited | logo = McArthurGlen Group logo.svg | founded = {{start date and age|1993}}{{cite news |author= |date=April 17, 1994 |title=74. McArthur/Glen Realty Corp. |url=https://www.washingtonpost.com/archive/business/1994/04/18/74-mcarthurglen-realty-corp/72ee5c4a-8d88-41bb-ba81-950ec35570ed |work=The Washington Post |access-date=February 7, 2025}} | founders = Cheryl McArthur, Alan Glen, Kaempfer Partners | num_locations = 22 (Jan 2026) | area_served = {{Ubl |[[Austria]] |[[Canada]] |[[France]] |[[Germany]] |[[Italy]] |[[Netherlands]] |[[Spain]] |[[United Kingdom]] |[[Belgium]] (formerly) |[[Greece]] (formerly) }} | industry = [[Shopping mall|Shopping mall operator]] | website = [https://www.mcarthurglengroup.com/ Official website] }} [[Image:McArthur Glen Designer Outlet Roermond.jpeg|thumb|Roermond Designer Outlet in the Netherlands]] [[File:McArthurGlen Designer Outlet Vancouver Airport (19002254413).jpg|thumb|McArthurGlen Designer Outlet at the [[Vancouver International Airport]]]] '''McArthurGlen UK Limited''' (trading as '''McArthurGlen Group''') is a British [[Shopping mall|shopping mall operator]], founded in 1993. The group manages 22 shopping malls across the UK and Europe, and has a singular location in Canada. Its destinations are often self-branded as McArthurGlen outlets. The group specializes in [[Designer outlet|factory outlet]] and luxury retail shopping malls.{{cite web |last1=Faull |first1=Jennifer |title=McArthurGlen launches The Art of Denim, its first ever global campaign, in partnership with Elle Magazine |url=http://www.thedrum.com/news/2013/08/22/mcarthurglen-launches-art-denim-its-first-ever-global-campaign-partnership-elle |accessdate=15 June 2015 |website=The Drum}} ==Background == In 1986, Cheryl McArthur and Alan Glen founded '''McArthur/Glen Realty Corp''' in the United States, a [[real estate investment trust]], which was later folded into Horizon Shopping Malls in the 1990s.{{Cite news |date=1994-04-18 |title=74. MCARTHUR/GLEN REALTY CORP. |url=https://www.washingtonpost.com/archive/business/1994/04/18/74-mcarthurglen-realty-corp/72ee5c4a-8d88-41bb-ba81-950ec35570ed/ |access-date=2025-12-12 |work=The Washington Post |language=en-US |issn=0190-8286}} In April 1993, McArthur and Glen, alongside Kaempfer Partners, founded '''McArthurGlen UK Limited''' as a separate company to the former American namesake. It opened its first mall in 1995, the [[Cheshire Oaks Designer Outlet]].{{Cite web |last=Porter |first=Gary |date=2025-08-09 |title=30 years of Cheshire Oaks - the UK's first and biggest designer outlet |url=https://www.cheshire-live.co.uk/news/chester-cheshire-news/gallery/30-years-cheshire-oaks-uks-32065327 |access-date=2025-12-12 |website=Cheshire Live |language=en}} In June 2013, [[Simon Property Group]] purchased a stake in the McArthurGlen Group.{{Cite web |last=United |first=Fashion |title=McArthurGlen |url=https://fashionunited.com/companies/mcarthurglen |access-date=2025-12-12 |website=fashionunited.com}} On 9 July 2015, McArthurGlen Group opened its first outlet in North America at Vancouver Airport.{{Cite web|url=https://ftnnews.com/luxury/27774-first-mcarthurglen-designer-outlet-in-north-america-opens-near-vancouver-airport|title=First McArthurGlen Designer Outlet in North America opens near Vancouver Airport|first=Ozgur|last=Tore|website=ftnnews.com|date=3 July 2015 }} During 2025 and 2026, 3 McArthurGlen properties were sold to [[Frasers Group]], the properties sold were [[Swindon Designer Outlet]], East Midlands Designer Outlet, and York Designer Outlet. They were all rebranded under the Frasers Plus brand.{{Cite web |date=2025-12-09 |title=Frasers Group purchases Swindon Designer Outlet - Retail Gazette |url=https://www.retailgazette.co.uk/blog/2025/12/frasers-swindon-designer-outlet/ |access-date=2025-12-09 |language=en-GB}}{{Cite web |last=Group |first=The Completely |last2=Oliver |first2=Jack |date=2026-04-30 |title=Frasers Group completes double acquisition of outlet centres |url=https://news.completelyretail.co.uk/frasers-group-completes-double-acquisition-of-outlet-centres/ |access-date=2026-04-30 |website=Completely Retail News |language=en}}{{Cite web |date=2026-06-30 |title=How major Yorkshire shopping centre could change after buy out by Sports Direct owner |url=https://www.thetelegraphandargus.co.uk/news/26239233.york-mcarthurglen-designer-outlet-fraser-group-rebrand-plans/ |access-date=2026-07-02 |website=Bradford Telegraph and Argus |language=en}} ==Current operations == ===Canada=== {|class="wikitable sortable" |- ! McArthurGlen UK Limited (trading as McArthurGlen Group) is a British shopping mall operator, founded in 1993.
The group manages 22 shopping malls across the UK and Europe, and has a singular location in Canada. Its destinations are often self-branded as McArthurGlen outlets. The group specializes in factory outlet and luxury retail shopping malls.
